summary: Implemented PD-05 node types. All acceptance criteria met. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.

changes.description: Updated NodeType enum: USER_TASK→HUMAN_TASK, SCRIPT_TASK→TIMER. Added attributes: ?[]const u8 = null field to GraphNode struct. Added public validateNodeAttributes() function and private helpers checkHumanTask(), checkServiceTask(), checkTimer(), isValidIso8601Duration().
Wired graph_mod.validateNodeAttributes() into Store.create() immediately after validateGraph() passes. Uses identical violation-storage and cleanup pattern as validateGraph() call.
Replaced all 12 occurrences of .USER_TASK with .HUMAN_TASK. Updated test name 'START → USER_TASK → END' to 'START → HUMAN_TASK → END'.
Replaced all 13 occurrences of .USER_TASK with .HUMAN_TASK (including comment line 'START → USER_TASK → END' and arena-allocated test node).

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: NodeType enum updated: HUMAN_TASK and TIMER present; USER_TASK and SCRIPT_TASK removed
GraphNode struct has optional attributes field
HUMAN_TASK validation: missing or empty role → HUMAN_TASK_MISSING_ROLE violation
SERVICE_TASK validation: missing endpoint → SERVICE_TASK_MISSING_ENDPOINT; missing timeout_ms → SERVICE_TASK_MISSING_TIMEOUT; timeout_ms <= 0 or > 300000 → SERVICE_TASK_INVALID_TIMEOUT
TIMER validation: missing duration_iso8601 → TIMER_MISSING_DURATION; invalid ISO 8601 string → TIMER_INVALID_DURATION
P0D (zero duration) is accepted as valid
validateNodeAttributes() is called in Store.create() after validateGraph() passes
Attribute validation failures surface as GraphValidationFailed with stored violations

notes: attributes field given default value null on GraphNode to preserve backward compatibility with all existing struct literals in tests.
validateNodeAttributes is a pure function (no I/O, no DB) matching the same contract as validateGraph.
JSON parsing uses std.json.parseFromSlice with Parsed.deinit() per Zig 0.16 stdlib pattern.
isValidIso8601Duration implements a left-to-right scan parser accepting P[nY][nM][nW][nD][T[nH][nM][nS]].
